blocks.text: The patriarchal setup among Filipinos has led to multiple gender burdens for women. Because of these prevalent beliefs, women lack adequate social protection, aggravating their employment insecurities and making them more vulnerable to poverty. Through this cultural practice of patriarchy, gender inequalities thrive. There are cases of subordination and inequality when it comes to gender, […]...
